text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see an Elder of the Brotherhood.
source_text: You see an Elder of the Brotherhood.

text: 你看见一位钢铁兄弟会的元老。
source_text: 你看见一位钢铁兄弟会的元老。

text: Greetings Initiate. I need to speak with you. (He motions for you to come closer.)
source_text: Greetings Initiate. I need to speak with you. (He motions for you to come closer.)

text: 你好新兵。我需要与你谈谈。【他靠近你。】
source_text: 你好新兵。我需要与你谈谈。【他靠近你。】

text: About what?
source_text: About what?

text: 关于什么？
source_text: 关于什么？

text: I don't have time right now.
source_text: I don't have time right now.

text: 我现在没有时间。
source_text: 我现在没有时间。

text: Err?
source_text: Err?

text: 呃？
source_text: 呃？

text: There is an urgent matter I need you to help me# with. It's Maxson. We are pretty sure he's gone off the# deep end. He keeps babbling about an army massing to the# north.
source_text:
There is an urgent matter I need you to help me
# with. It's Maxson. We are pretty sure he's gone off the
# deep end. He keeps babbling about an army massing to the
# north.

text: 我需要你帮助我解决一个紧急的问题。我们确信马克松犯了大错。他老是胡扯什么要把军队在北方集结。
source_text: 我需要你帮助我解决一个紧急的问题。我们确信马克松犯了大错。他老是胡扯什么要把军队在北方集结。

text: I'm not willing to send our troops up there into# possibly radiated areas, unless I've got absolute proof# that this "army" exists.
source_text:
I'm not willing to send our troops up there into
# possibly radiated areas, unless I've got absolute proof
# that this "army" exists.

text: 我不愿意派遣我们的军队进入可能有幅射的区域，除非我已经得到绝对的证据表明那有支“军队”存在。
source_text: 我不愿意派遣我们的军队进入可能有幅射的区域，除非我已经得到绝对的证据表明那有支“军队”存在。

text: I need someone who isn't a friend of the old man.# Someone I can get an honest report from. Are you willing to check# the northern region?
source_text:
I need someone who isn't a friend of the old man.
# Someone I can get an honest report from. Are you willing to check
# the northern region?

text: 我需要一个不是那老人朋友的人。我可以从那人得到一份诚实的报告。你愿意去北方的区域看看吗？
source_text: 我需要一个不是那老人朋友的人。我可以从那人得到一份诚实的报告。你愿意去北方的区域看看吗？

text: I'll do it.
source_text: I'll do it.

text: 我去做。
source_text: 我去做。

text: I can't do it right now. I've got other things I need to deal with.
source_text: I can't do it right now. I've got other things I need to deal with.

text: 我现在不行。还有其他事情需要我去处理。
source_text: 我现在不行。还有其他事情需要我去处理。

text: I've already seen a base to the north run by an army of mutants.
source_text: I've already seen a base to the north run by an army of mutants.

text: 我已经在北方看见被变种人军队控制的基地了。
source_text: 我已经在北方看见被变种人军队控制的基地了。

text: Good. First go talk to Maxson if you haven't already. Report back# to me when you've checked the northern territory. After that, we'll decide# what to do with Maxson.
source_text:
Good. First go talk to Maxson if you haven't already. Report back
# to me when you've checked the northern territory. After that, we'll decide
# what to do with Maxson.

text: 好的。如果你还没见过马克松，先去和他谈谈。当你侦查完北面后回来向我汇报。然后呢，我再和马克松确定下一步计划。
source_text: 好的。如果你还没见过马克松，先去和他谈谈。当你侦查完北面后回来向我汇报。然后呢，我再和马克松确定下一步计划。

text: Wish me luck.
source_text: Wish me luck.

text: 祝我好运。
source_text: 祝我好运。

text: Have you explored the entire northern territory?
source_text: Have you explored the entire northern territory?

text: 你探察了全部北方地区？
source_text: 你探察了全部北方地区？

text: Yes.
source_text: Yes.

text: 是的。
source_text: 是的。

text: No.
source_text: No.

text: 不。
source_text: 不。

text: And what do you have to report?
source_text: And what do you have to report?

text: 你有什么要汇报？
source_text: 你有什么要汇报？

text: I've found a base guarded by heavily armed mutants. It looks pretty bad.
source_text: I've found a base guarded by heavily armed mutants. It looks pretty bad.

text: 我发现了一个由全副武装变种人守卫的基地。情况看起来相当不好。
source_text: 我发现了一个由全副武装变种人守卫的基地。情况看起来相当不好。

text: I didn't think so. You weren't gone for very long. Now, get back out there and# don't come back until you have a FULL report.
source_text:
I didn't think so. You weren't gone for very long. Now, get back out there and
# don't come back until you have a FULL report.

text: 我不这么认为。你没去很长时间。现在，回到那边去并且不要这么快回来，直到你有一份完整的报告。
source_text: 我不这么认为。你没去很长时间。现在，回到那边去并且不要这么快回来，直到你有一份完整的报告。

text: Yes, sir.
source_text: Yes, sir.

text: 是的，先生。
source_text: 是的，先生。

text: I will inform the Elders. We will wait for Maxson's word on what to do.# Go inform him on what you've found. Thanks for your help, Initiate.
source_text:
I will inform the Elders. We will wait for Maxson's word on what to do.
# Go inform him on what you've found. Thanks for your help, Initiate.

text: 我将通知元老们。我们会等马克松作出决定该干什么。去告诉他你的发现。感谢你的帮助，新兵。
source_text: 我将通知元老们。我们会等马克松作出决定该干什么。去告诉他你的发现。感谢你的帮助，新兵。

text: You're welcome.
source_text: You're welcome.

text: 不用客气。
source_text: 不用客气。

text: Then you will make time to hear me out.
source_text: Then you will make time to hear me out.

text: 你会有时间听完我的话。
source_text: 你会有时间听完我的话。

text: You've got my attention.
source_text: You've got my attention.

text: 你得到我的注意。
source_text: 你得到我的注意。

text: You can go to hell old man.
source_text: You can go to hell old man.

text: 去死吧老东西。
source_text: 去死吧老东西。

text: Forget it. I've got more important things to do.
source_text: Forget it. I've got more important things to do.

text: 忘了它。我有更重要的事要做。
source_text: 忘了它。我有更重要的事要做。

text: I understand. If you do travel up into that area and find anything, please, let me know.
source_text: I understand. If you do travel up into that area and find anything, please, let me know.

text: 我了解。如果你进入那个地区并且发现了什么，拜托，告诉我。
source_text: 我了解。如果你进入那个地区并且发现了什么，拜托，告诉我。

text: If I find anything that resembles an army up north, I will let you know.
source_text: If I find anything that resembles an army up north, I will let you know.

text: 如果我发现在北方有类似军队的任何事，我将告诉你。
source_text: 如果我发现在北方有类似军队的任何事，我将告诉你。

text: Good work with the mutants. We already heard that you destroyed their# production facility. Thanks for taking care of that problem for us.
source_text:
Good work with the mutants. We already heard that you destroyed their
# production facility. Thanks for taking care of that problem for us.

text: 干的好。我们已经听到了你破坏他们制造设备的事。谢谢为我们解决了那个问题。
source_text: 干的好。我们已经听到了你破坏他们制造设备的事。谢谢为我们解决了那个问题。

text: No problem.
source_text: No problem.

text: 没问题。
source_text: 没问题。

text: Err? What kind of response is Err? Leave! Now!
source_text: Err? What kind of response is Err? Leave! Now!

text: 呃？算什么意思？快滚！
source_text: 呃？算什么意思？快滚！

text: If it was up to me, you would be out of here.
source_text: If it was up to me, you would be out of here.

text: 如果依我的意思，你最好离开。
source_text: 如果依我的意思，你最好离开。

text: I have nothing to say to you.
source_text: I have nothing to say to you.

text: 我对你无话可说。
source_text: 我对你无话可说。

text: You should learn some respect.
source_text: You should learn some respect.

text: 你应该学习一些尊敬。
source_text: 你应该学习一些尊敬。

text: The meeting will come to order. All Elders are present and have# agreed to hear out the claims of Brother
source_text:
The meeting will come to order. All Elders are present and have
# agreed to hear out the claims of Brother

text: 会议即将举行。全体元老在场并且同意听取
source_text: 会议即将举行。全体元老在场并且同意听取

text: . We shall determine what actions will be taken. Brother
source_text: . We shall determine what actions will be taken. Brother

text: 兄弟的陈述。我们将确定采取什么行动。
source_text: 兄弟的陈述。我们将确定采取什么行动。

text: , tell us what you have seen to the north.
source_text: , tell us what you have seen to the north.

text: 兄弟，告诉我们你在北方看到了什么。
source_text: 兄弟，告诉我们你在北方看到了什么。

text: During my explorations, I found a military installation being used# by mutants. It is heavily guarded and patrolled regularly.
source_text:
During my explorations, I found a military installation being used
# by mutants. It is heavily guarded and patrolled regularly.

text: 在我的探险期间，我发现了变种人使用的一座军事设施。它被严密地保护着。
source_text: 在我的探险期间，我发现了变种人使用的一座军事设施。它被严密地保护着。

text: Norfa?
source_text: Norfa?

text: 北方？
source_text: 北方？

text: And what did these mutants look like?
source_text: And what did these mutants look like?

text: 这些变种人看起来像什么？
source_text: 这些变种人看起来像什么？

text: They are large humanoids. Their muscle mass is well beyond what a# regular human could ever gain. There appear to be several of them guarding the# gate in organized troops.
source_text:
They are large humanoids. Their muscle mass is well beyond what a
# regular human could ever gain. There appear to be several of them guarding the
# gate in organized troops.

text: 他们是巨大的类人动物。他们的肌肉块远远超过一般的人类。那里他们有人守在大门口，像是有严密组织的军队。
source_text: 他们是巨大的类人动物。他们的肌肉块远远超过一般的人类。那里他们有人守在大门口，像是有严密组织的军队。

text: They were big, greenish, and carrying weapons.
source_text: They were big, greenish, and carrying weapons.

text: 他们是巨大的，绿色的, 并且带着武器。
source_text: 他们是巨大的，绿色的, 并且带着武器。

text: As you may know, our Head Scribe, Vree, has done an autopsy on a# creature very similar to what you have just described. Do you believe these# are the same?
source_text:
As you may know, our Head Scribe, Vree, has done an autopsy on a
# creature very similar to what you have just described. Do you believe these
# are the same?

text: 正如您所知，我们的首席研究员弗蕾，对和你刚刚描述的非常相似的生物做过一个解剖。你相信他们是相同的？
source_text: 正如您所知，我们的首席研究员弗蕾，对和你刚刚描述的非常相似的生物做过一个解剖。你相信他们是相同的？

text: Yes. The description of the creature is nearly identical.
source_text: Yes. The description of the creature is nearly identical.

text: 是的。生物的描述是几乎相同的。
source_text: 是的。生物的描述是几乎相同的。

text: What threat do you assume these "mutants" pose?
source_text: What threat do you assume these "mutants" pose?

text: 你认为这些“变种人”会有什么威胁？
source_text: 你认为这些“变种人”会有什么威胁？

text: Just as the Brotherhood has been gearing up for battle, this "mutant# army" has been preparing for something big.
source_text:
Just as the Brotherhood has been gearing up for battle, this "mutant
# army" has been preparing for something big.

text: 正如钢铁兄弟会已经为战争作好准备，这些“变种人军队”正准备有些大动作。
source_text: 正如钢铁兄弟会已经为战争作好准备，这些“变种人军队”正准备有些大动作。

text: Frankly, your report has not shown us any proof that they are a# threat to us. What proof can you give that they have hostile intentions.
source_text:
Frankly, your report has not shown us any proof that they are a
# threat to us. What proof can you give that they have hostile intentions.

text: 坦白说，你的报告未能证明他们对我们的威胁。你有什么证据能够表明他们怀有敌意。
source_text: 坦白说，你的报告未能证明他们对我们的威胁。你有什么证据能够表明他们怀有敌意。

text: They have invaded Necropolis. They won't stop there.
source_text: They have invaded Necropolis. They won't stop there.

text: 他们侵略了大墓地。他们不会停留在那里。
source_text: 他们侵略了大墓地。他们不会停留在那里。

text: They are gathering an army. A heavily armed army. They certainly aren't# going to just parade around. They intend to use it.
source_text:
They are gathering an army. A heavily armed army. They certainly aren't
# going to just parade around. They intend to use it.

text: 他们正在集结军队。一支全副武装的军队。他们不是恰好在附近行军。他们是想要进攻。
source_text: 他们正在集结军队。一支全副武装的军队。他们不是恰好在附近行军。他们是想要进攻。

text: So, by these actions they are taking, it is feasable that they will eventually# come here?
source_text:
So, by these actions they are taking, it is feasable that they will eventually
# come here?

text: 那么，根据他们当前行动所显示，他们最终可能会来这里？
source_text: 那么，根据他们当前行动所显示，他们最终可能会来这里？

text: It is possible that they are already on their way here. The Brotherhood is# the only real opposition they could have.
source_text:
It is possible that they are already on their way here. The Brotherhood is
# the only real opposition they could have.

text: 他们可能已经在来这里的途中了。钢铁兄弟会是唯一能够对抗他们的人。
source_text: 他们可能已经在来这里的途中了。钢铁兄弟会是唯一能够对抗他们的人。

text: I don't believe that shows hostility. They could simply be protecting themselves# from attack. Even we have to deal with the occasional attack.
source_text:
I don't believe that shows hostility. They could simply be protecting themselves
# from attack. Even we have to deal with the occasional attack.

text: 我不相信那表示敌意。他们可能只是简单的保护他们自己免受攻击。哪怕是我们也必须应对偶然的袭击。
source_text: 我不相信那表示敌意。他们可能只是简单的保护他们自己免受攻击。哪怕是我们也必须应对偶然的袭击。

text: If they attack, it will be NOTHING like the occasional attack you get from# the raiders. This will be a slaughter.
source_text:
If they attack, it will be NOTHING like the occasional attack you get from
# the raiders. This will be a slaughter.

text: 如果他们攻击，那可不会是以前那种强盗的骚扰。这将会是一场屠杀。
source_text: 如果他们攻击，那可不会是以前那种强盗的骚扰。这将会是一场屠杀。

text: Since they are coming out of that old military installation, I would imagine# that they would have weapons comparable to your own.
source_text:
Since they are coming out of that old military installation, I would imagine
# that they would have weapons comparable to your own.

text: 因为他们从那个老军事基地出来，我可以想象他们的武器不比你们的差。
source_text: 因为他们从那个老军事基地出来，我可以想象他们的武器不比你们的差。

text: What do you suggest? A preemptive strike at their military base?
source_text: What do you suggest? A preemptive strike at their military base?

text: 你建议什么？先去袭击他们的军事基地？
source_text: 你建议什么？先去袭击他们的军事基地？

text: Yes. I don't want them to know we are coming though.  A small team would# stand a better chance of getting into their perimeter without being detected.
source_text:
Yes. I don't want them to know we are coming though.  A small team would
# stand a better chance of getting into their perimeter without being detected.

text: 是的。我不想让他们知道我们的行动。一个小规模的队伍有利于安全的潜入他们的地界。
source_text: 是的。我不想让他们知道我们的行动。一个小规模的队伍有利于安全的潜入他们的地界。

text: That will only take care of one part of the problem. They're being led by a# group coming out of the Boneyard Cathedral.
source_text:
That will only take care of one part of the problem. They're being led by a
# group coming out of the Boneyard Cathedral.

text: 这只能说明一部分问题。他们被晒骨场大教堂的另一支小队领导。
source_text: 这只能说明一部分问题。他们被晒骨场大教堂的另一支小队领导。

If they are being led by a group out of the Boneyard Cathdral, then chances are

text: 如果他们被晒骨场的大教堂领导，那么有可能他们也在那里驻扎了一小队人马。
source_text: 如果他们被晒骨场的大教堂领导，那么有可能他们也在那里驻扎了一小队人马。

text: If we take them out in the north, then it leaves our south side vulnerable.# I can only spare a few men on this endeavor.

text: 如果我们从北方带他们出去，那我们的南边会很容易受到攻击。我只能尽量在这留一些人。
